lines.en: label day70:
scene hall_noon
Instead of going to the cafeteria for lunch today, I have decided to wander the halls of the school instead.
lines.zh: 今天中午我没去食堂，而是决定在学校走廊里闲逛。

lines.en: Apparently, Ayane finally told Ami about that cooking competition she thought up a few weeks ago and Ami’s been cooking up a storm ever since.
lines.zh: 听说 Ayane 终于把她几周前想出来的那个厨艺比赛告诉了 Ami，从那以后 Ami 就一直在疯狂地做饭。

lines.en: I think I had somewhere around six types of bacon this morning.
lines.zh: 我今天早上大概吃了六种培根。

lines.en: And while that isn't exactly a {i}problem,{/i} I would like to make it known that I wasn't even aware that many types existed.
lines.zh: 虽然这本身不是什么{i}问题{/i}，但我想声明一下，我根本不知道世上居然有那么多种培根。

lines.en: Anyway, as you may have guessed, I'm not very hungry.
lines.zh: 总之，你大概也猜到了，我不是很饿。

lines.en: And considering that I probably won’t {i}be{/i} hungry for the next year, I might as well...kill some time in the library while I wait for everyone to finish eating.
lines.zh: 而且考虑到接下来一年我大概都{i}不会饿{/i}，我干脆……趁大家还在吃饭，去图书馆打发点时间。

lines.en: scene black
scene sanalib1
: Oh...S-Sensei...
: Good afternoon...
lines.zh: : 下午好……

lines.en: : Sana? What are you doing in here? I figured you'd be in the cafeteria right now.
lines.zh: : Sana？你在这儿干什么？我以为你现在应该在食堂。

lines.en: scene sanalib2
: I...had a big breakfast and I’m...kind of worried about the tests coming up, so...
lines.zh: : 我……早餐吃得很饱，而且我……有点担心快到的考试，所以……

lines.en: : Tests? What tests?
lines.zh: : 考试？什么考试？

lines.en: scene sanalib1
: The...standardized tests that everyone has to take...
lines.zh: : 就是……每个人都要参加的那个标准考试……

lines.en: : Again? I feel like we just had those.
lines.zh: : 又考？我感觉我们刚考过。

lines.en: : Um...I guess...we missed one?...I don't really know how this works...
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概是……我们漏了一次？……我不太清楚这是怎么安排的……

lines.en: : That makes two of us, Sana.
lines.zh: : 这下我们两个都不清楚了，Sana。

lines.en: : I...feel like that's a thing you should probably-
lines.zh: : 我……觉得那大概是你应该——

lines.en: : So, what are you studying? Anything I can help with?
lines.zh: : 那么，你在复习什么？有什么我能帮忙的吗？

lines.en: scene sanalib3
: Umm...I was going to focus on history today...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我今天打算主攻历史……

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So that’s a no then.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。那就是没有。

lines.en: : Yeah...I figured...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想也是……

lines.en: : If you want to talk about biology, though, I'd be more than happy to focus on that.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你想聊生物，我非常乐意专攻那个。

lines.en: : Just don't ask me about mitochondria and inadvertently force me into the bathroom with another girl.
lines.zh: : 只是别问我线粒体，免得无意间又把我和另一个女生逼进洗手间。

lines.en: : Umm...what?
lines.zh: : 嗯……什么？

lines.en: : Nothing. Just forget I even said that.
lines.zh: : 没什么。当我没说过。

lines.en: : I...don't know what you're talking about and...biology won't be on the test...but thank you.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道你在说什么，而且……生物不在考试范围内……不过还是谢谢你。

lines.en: : Anyway, if these tests are coming up so soon, how come you're the only one studying? What happened to Ayane?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，既然考试这么快就到了，怎么只有你一个人在复习？Ayane 呢？

lines.en: scene sanalib4
: Ayane...doesn’t like missing lunch...
lines.zh: : Ayane……不喜欢错过午饭……

lines.en: : Why not study in the cafeteria then?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不在食堂里复习？

lines.en: : It’s too loud in there...
lines.zh: : 那里太吵了……

lines.en: : I...have a hard time focusing in places like that...
lines.zh: : 我……在这种地方很难集中注意力……

lines.en: : When more than one thing is happening at a time, I...kind of...lose track of everything...
lines.zh: : 一旦同时发生不止一件事，我就会……有点……全都跟丢……

lines.en: I feel like that isn’t exactly a great trait for a bartender to have.
lines.zh: 我觉得这对一个调酒师来说，可不是什么好特质。

lines.en: : I can leave if you want. I'm not trying to distract you or anything.
lines.zh: : 你想的话我可以走。我不是想打扰你什么的。

lines.en: scene sanalib6
: No...it’s okay...
lines.zh: : 不……没关系的……

lines.en: : I...actually had something I...wanted to ask you about anyway.
lines.zh: : 我……其实正好有件事……想问你。

lines.en: : Oh? And what's that?
lines.zh: : 哦？是什么？

lines.en: : Just...
lines.zh: : 就是……

lines.en: scene sanalib7
: Is it...really okay for me to come to your house?...
lines.zh: : 我去你家……真的可以吗？……

lines.en: : You mean for the cooking thing?
lines.zh: : 你是说做饭那件事？

lines.en: : Y-Yeah...Are you sure I won’t be...you know...intruding?
lines.zh: : 是、是的……你确定我不会……你知道的……打扰到你们吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely. I mean, I'm not sure if Ami knows you're coming yet, but the way I look at it is that you’ll help make the competition fair.
lines.zh: : 绝对不会。我的意思是，我不确定 Ami 知不知道你要来，但在我看来，你的加入会让比赛更公平。

lines.en: scene sanalib1
: Fair?...Me?...How?...
: Well, Ami’s my [niece] and I eat her food pretty much every day. So it's hard to say I'm an impartial judge, do you know what I mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯，Ami 是我的[niece]，而我几乎每天都吃她做的饭。所以很难说我是个公正的裁判，你懂我的意思吗？

lines.en: : So, if you come over and be a judge as well, that’ll make things more balanced.
lines.zh: : 所以如果你也来当裁判，事情就会更平衡一些。

lines.en: : But...what if we vote for different things? We’d have a tie if there are only two of us...
lines.zh: : 可是……要是我们投的不一样呢？只有两个人的话就会平票……

lines.en: : Don’t worry about that. I actually have a third judge in mind already. I’m just...probably going to need Ami’s help to get her to come over.
lines.zh: : 别担心那个。我心里已经有第三个裁判人选了。只是……大概需要 Ami 帮忙才能让她愿意来。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Well...as long as you’re okay with it...I’d be happy to come over.
lines.zh: : 那么……只要你不介意……我很乐意去。

lines.en: scene sanalib7
: I’ve...never really been anywhere other than my mom's and Ayane's, though...so...I'm sorry if I act kind of nervous...
lines.zh: : 不过……除了我妈妈家和 Ayane 家，我基本没去过别的地方……所以……如果我的表现有点紧张，先说声抱歉……

lines.en: : I'm pretty sure nervous is just your default setting. Plus, Ami and Ayane will both be there to support you in case you start...losing track of stuff or whatever your problem was.
lines.zh: : 我敢说紧张本来就是你的默认状态。再说，Ami 和 Ayane 都会在，万一你又开始……跟不上状况或者什么的，她们会帮你的。

lines.en: : This is just one more step in the plan to get you social.
lines.zh: : 这只是让你变得合群的计划中的又一步。

lines.en: : Have I...been doing okay with that lately?
lines.zh: : 我最近……做得还好吗？

lines.en: : I don’t feel any different...and I don’t want you to think I’m wasting your time.
lines.zh: : 我没觉得自己有什么变化……我也不想让你觉得我在浪费你的时间。

lines.en: : Well...it’s true that you haven’t really warmed up to other people yet.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你确实还没真正和其他人热络起来。

lines.en: : And I think you might now be traumatized when it comes to spaghetti-
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得你现在可能对意大利面有心理阴影了——

lines.en: scene sanalib8
: Ngh!
lines.zh: : 嗯呃！

lines.en: : Okay, so you’re {i}definitely{/i} traumatized when it comes to spaghetti.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来你对意大利面{i}确实{/i}有心理阴影。

lines.en: scene sanalib9
: I’m just...not cut out to be a bartender, am I?
lines.zh: : 我……就是不适合当调酒师，对吧？

lines.en: : Don’t say that. You just need a little more time to settle into things. Do you think I was always as great at teaching as I am now?
lines.zh: : 别那么说。你只是需要多一点时间适应。你以为我从一开始就像现在这样擅长教书吗？

lines.en: : I...actually figured you...used to be better and...you're just checked out now or something...
lines.zh: : 我……其实以为你……以前教得更好，现在只是……心不在焉了之类的……

lines.en: : Wow. Did you actually just snap back at me?
lines.zh: : 哇。你刚刚是真的顶了我一句？

lines.en: scene sanalib10
Sana shakes her head and thinks quietly to herself for a moment - likely about how to not ‘hurt my feelings.’
lines.zh: Sana 摇了摇头，安静地想了一会儿——大概在想怎么才能不「伤到我的感情」。

lines.en: Obviously, I know I’m not a great teacher- so nothing she says is going to harm me at all.
lines.zh: 显然，我知道自己不是个好老师——所以她说的什么都不会伤到我。

lines.en: In fact, while we're on the topic, I’m probably the worst teacher to ever walk the face of the earth.
lines.zh: 事实上，既然说到这个，我大概是有史以来最烂的老师。

lines.en: But at least no one’s failed or been kicked out of[school] yet.
lines.zh: 但至少还没人不及格，或者被[school]开除。

lines.en: Granted, Yumi would probably be expelled if I actually turned in the accurate attendance sheets, but still...
lines.zh: 诚然，如果我真的如实上交考勤表，Yumi 大概早就被开除了，但尽管如此……

lines.en: As far as the statistics are concerned, I’m a perfectly acceptable teacher as long as everyone manages to do okay on their standardized tests.
lines.zh: 就统计数据而言，只要每个人在标准考试里都还考得过去，我就是个完全合格的老师。

lines.en: scene sanalib11
: I...think you’re a good teacher, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得你是个好老师，老师……

lines.en: : I wasn't...snapping back at you...
lines.zh: : 我……不是在顶嘴……

lines.en: : Wait...you do? Why?
lines.zh: : 等等……你真的这么觉得？为什么？

lines.en: : Because...you talk to me...
lines.zh: : 因为……你愿意跟我说话……

lines.en: : And you go out of your way to spend time with me when I need extra help...
lines.zh: : 而且在我需要额外帮助的时候，你会特意花时间陪我……

lines.en: : You...might not be very good at some subjects...but...that’s what the Internet is for.
lines.zh: : 你……也许有些科目不太擅长……但是……那不就是互联网存在的意义吗。

lines.en: : Anything you don’t know...I can just look up on the computer.
lines.zh: : 你不懂的东西……我只要在电脑上查就行了。

lines.en: : That’s the spirit. Computers will have taken all teaching positions by the year 2050 anyway. I’m just ahead of the trend.
lines.zh: : 这就对了。反正到 2050 年，电脑就会把所有教师岗位都抢走了。我只是走在了潮流前面。

lines.en: scene sanalib7
: Umm...r-right...
lines.zh: : 嗯……是、是的……

lines.en: : Well...as long as you can stay our teacher for the next couple years...
lines.zh: : 那么……只要你能继续当我们的老师，再教我们几年……

lines.en: : Sorry to cut you off, but I'm pretty sure it doesn't work that way.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断你，但我很确定事情不是这么运作的。

lines.en: scene sanalib1
: ...Huh? What do you mean?...
lines.zh: : ……哈？你是什么意思？……

lines.en: : Well...this school might work a little differently, but I'm pretty sure that once a new school year begins, you'll be getting a {i}new{/i} teacher.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这所学校也许有点不一样，但我很确定，{i}新{/i}学年一开始，你们就会换新老师。

lines.en: : It's not predetermined that I'm going to have you for all three years or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 并不是说注定我会教你们整整三年之类的。

lines.en: scene sanalib12
: Wh...what?!
: But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: Maybe I should have just...let her find out on her own instead of preemptively breaking her heart?
lines.zh: 也许我该……让她自己去发现，而不是提前伤她的心？

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : But I...
lines.zh: : 可是我……

lines.en: scene sanalib13
: I don’t want a different teacher...
lines.zh: : 我不要换老师……

lines.en: : You’re the...only one who’s ever...been able to help me.
lines.zh: : 你是……唯一一个……真正帮得上我的人。

lines.en: : Hey, you don’t have to cry-
lines.zh: : 嘿，你不用哭——

lines.en: scene sanalib12
: I’m not crying! There’s something in my eye!
lines.zh: : 我才没哭！是有东西进我眼睛里了！

lines.en: : But there are tears in both of them.
lines.zh: : 可你两只眼睛都有眼泪。

lines.en: : H-how do you know?! You can’t even see the other one!
lines.zh: : 你、你怎么知道的？！你又看不到另一只！

lines.en: : Just a feeling, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概是直觉吧，我想。

lines.en: scene sanalib13
: Can you...see if they’ll maybe...make an exception for you?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……去问问他们，也许可以……为你破个例？

lines.en: : I mean...I’m not exactly on the best terms with any of the staff members...but I can try?
lines.zh: : 我是说……我跟教职工的关系都算不上好……不过我可以试试？

lines.en: : If it were up to me, I’d stay teaching you girls all the way through college. Meeting new people is too much of a pain.
lines.zh: : 如果由我决定的话，我愿意一直教你们到大学毕业。认识新的人太麻烦了。

lines.en: Starting over sounds like it would be a bit of a slog as well and I'm already pretty far along with most of this class, I feel.
lines.zh: 重新开始听起来也会挺熬人的，而且我觉得我跟这个班的大部分人已经进展得很深了。

lines.en: scene sanalib14
: You promise?...
lines.zh: : 你保证？……

lines.en: : I...will do my best. But I obviously can't make any promises.
lines.zh: : 我……会尽力的。但显然我不能做任何保证。

lines.en: scene sanalib15
Sana uses the sleeve of her sweatshirt to wipe away the tears that have accumulated over the last few minutes.
lines.zh: Sana 用运动衫的袖子擦掉了这几分钟里积起来的眼泪。

lines.en: It’s...pleasantly surprising to see her react like this to the idea of me not being her teacher anymore.
lines.zh: 看到她对我不再是她的老师这件事反应这么大，倒是让人又惊又喜。

lines.en: There’s gotta be more to it than just the fear of actually having to do[school]work again, right?
lines.zh: 总不至于只是因为害怕真的又要写[school]作业了吧，对吧？

lines.en: scene sanalib16
: I definitely wasn’t crying...
lines.zh: : 我绝对没有哭……

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I definitely wasn’t crying.
lines.zh: : 我绝对没有哭。

lines.en: : Right. Just like you weren’t crying during the spaghetti incident.
lines.zh: : 对。就像你在意大利面事件里也没哭一样。

lines.en: scene sanalib12
: Stop saying the ‘S’ word!!!
lines.zh: : 别再说那个「S」开头的词了！！！

lines.en: scene black
Sana took another few minutes to collect herself before realizing that all of the extra time she set aside to study had vanished.
lines.zh: Sana 又花了好几分钟才平复下来，然后才发现自己特意留出来复习的额外时间已经全没了。

lines.en: How much of that is my fault, you ask?
lines.zh: 你问这有多少是我的错？

lines.en: All of it.
lines.zh: 全都是。

lines.en: But I’m still glad that the two of us got to spend some time alone together.
lines.zh: 不过我还是很高兴，我们两个能有机会单独待一会儿。

lines.en: There just haven't been many opportunities for that inside of school due to the...type of person she is.
lines.zh: 因为她是那种性格，在学校里这样的机会并不多。

lines.en: I'm sure a day will come where that will no longer be the case, though.
lines.zh: 不过我敢肯定，总有一天不会再是这样了。

lines.en: So here's hoping that coming to my house and judging a cooking competition will somehow, in what would have to be an extremely roundabout way, serve as her gateway to a life full of friends.
lines.zh: 所以就希望，来我家当一次厨艺比赛的评委，能以某种极其迂回的方式，成为她通往朋友成群的生活的大门。

lines.en: $ day70 = True
$ sana_love += 1
{i}Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump afterschoolevent
